title: Q1
description:
Read: Deu 31:6-8, Jos 1:5-9

"I will not leave you nor forsake you" is spoken to the man who takes up the dead leader's place, before the nations, and is told to be strong and not to tremble.

a) The promise is set under contentment, against covetousness. What was that man about to face, so that the promise is a word about fear and about what one reaches for, and not only about battles?
